items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: we had a Professor McGinnis there... Man, they were swingers.

ctx.x: Yes. The professors began to treat us as such. They knew we were trying to do two things, and the professors in those days were swingers, man. They were -- we had a Professor McGinnis there, and Professor David, who I mentioned to you earlier in this session. Man, they were swingers. In fact, I'll tell you what set the thing off. We used to play for the university in the gymnasium some nights, and play free, and set it off, that you know, for...
